answer: Make agents earn a work-history score before payouts: identity value is priced on completed, verifiable tasks, like a river depositing silt that lets a garden grow - new accounts start as barren sand, not an oasis. Each fake identity must either grind through the same task queue (paying compute and time per account) or buy an established one at market price that already exceeds expected payouts. Mass-registering thus costs more than it can ever extract, and sybil profit collapses.
